sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.market_ticker) s.market_ticker, s.at, s.best_yes_bid, s.best_no_bid, s.est_yes_score_total, s.est_no_score_total, s.est_yes_meets_target, s.est_no_meets_target, p.series_ticker, p.event_ticker, p.period_reward_usd, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.close_time, p.target_size, p.market_title FROM incentive_market_snapshots s JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id = s.program_row_id WHERE s.at > '2026-11-08T00:48:01+00:00' AND s.book_valid AND coalesce(p.incentive_type, '') ILIKE '%liquid%' AND p.end_date > '2026-11-08T03:48:01+00:00' ORDER BY s.market_ticker, s.at DESC
